eval.title: I've watched this Exxon (NYSE:XOM) movie already...

call.headline_quote: I'm sorry I'm not buying it because as I said oil prices higher benefited for exons Last 5 Years and current cash printing situation

reasons.claim: Exxon's great last-five-year performance was mainly driven by rising oil prices expanding margins, not durable business improvement, and this movie ends badly when supply catches up.
reasons.quote: oil prices went up almost 40% from 50 to an average okay let's say 50% up on margins when you let's say drill at 30 and sell at 50 your margins are 20 when you sell at 70 80 your margins are 40
